game.desc: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Game of the Year Edition combines the original Oblivion role-playing game for the Xbox 360, The Shivering Isles expansion and the Knights of the Nine content add-on in a single box. Beginners can start the adventure and discover the world of Oblivion, while those who have already played the base game can restart their adventure and enjoy the new features of the game.
